data.name: SCP [REDACTED]
data.detailed_description:
SCP [REDACTED] is a first-person survival horror game.

From the creator of the original Containment Breach level editor comes a terrifying new vision of the SCP universe. Enter a dark underground complex where horrors and anomalies threaten your every move. Playing as ███ ████, a ███████ trapped inside this enigmatic facility, your mission is to uncover the secrets behind the facility, survive relentless threats, and escape alive.

[CLASSIFIED: SUBJECT UNDER OBSERVATION]

[DATA EXPUNGED]

[ACCESS RESTRICTED]

A Dynamic, Unpredictable Threat

Face dynamic and unpredictable ███████ that react to sound, light, and movement. Driven by complex behaviors and goals, internal states, and external factors, these intelligent and reactive enemies make each encounter unique. No two playthroughs are alike. Your choices and actions will shape the evolving threat landscape and determine your fate.

An Interactive, Immersive World

Solve puzzles, find alternate routes, craft makeshift tools, and interact with your environment using tactile, physics-based mechanics. Every decision impacts your environment, creating a tense, reactive atmosphere where survival hinges on creativity and observation.

Descend into Darkness

Investigate what led to the disaster and discover the true nature of the horror lurking within. Collect scarce resources, experiment with different approaches, and uncover the [DATA CORRUPTED] of the SCP facility. Every choice you make influences the outcome, with multiple solutions to try.

[LOG ENTRY #073-██]

We communicated with them. We've seen the other side. Only the brave or the foolish will find it.

The Most Moddable SCP Game Ever

SCP Editor is included, with a full suite of mod creation tools, allowing you to craft your own scenarios and stories. Bring your scariest ideas to life and share them with the community to expand the game in endless ways, making the game an unlimited horror sandbox.

Features

  • Intelligent enemies that react and adapt to your actions

  • Constant tension with relentless threats and unpredictable encounters

  • Physics-based interactions for immersive puzzle-solving and obstacle navigation

  • Resource scavenging and crafting to survive and manipulate the environment

  • Non-linear, open-ended gameplay with multiple solutions and paths

  • Full modding support for an endless stream of user-created experiences to try

  • Powered by Leadwerks 5, our own in-house engine meticulously crafted to deliver the optimal player experience

=== END TRANSMISSION ===

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 Cores
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 6 Cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GEForce 3060 or AMD Radeon 6600

linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux
  • Processor: 6 Cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GEForce 3060 or AMD Radeon 6600

content_descriptors.notes: The game portrays acts of violence against human beings, dead bodies, and frightening or disturbing creatures designed to elicit a fear response in the player.
